purpose: Determine whether a longitudinal Antarctic test of terrestrial breeding-opportunity change versus penguin breeding-space change is technically identifiable before any new demographic outcome is opened.
paper1_boundary: Do not modify, retune, or reopen the closed cross-scale concentration submission endpoints.

source_roster.primary: Reuse the already-frozen Paper 2 temporal-support cohort: 107 Pygoscelis site x species units spanning 1980-2025, joined only to outcome-blind site coordinates and static atlas metadata.
allowed_demographic_fields: first and last seasons with a candidate nest-count observation
number/list of seasons with a candidate nest-count observation
prohibited_demographic_fields_during_aud: any label derived from whether abundance increased or declined

terrestrial_support.goal: Assess whether change in accessible ice-free breeding opportunity can be measured over each demographic record without using demographic magnitudes.
candidate_sources: Landsat Collection 2 archive for historical and recent optical support
Sentinel-2 L2A for recent validation where it overlaps the demographic record
SCAR Antarctic Digital Database 2026 coastline / rock-outcrop geometry for QA only
terrestrial_support.warning: Do not estimate habitat change by naively differencing successive SCAR ADD releases because source dates vary among features. Landsat Level-2 surface reflectance is also not treated as definitive absence of imagery at high latitudes; the catalog audit is a support screen, not the final pixel-level eligibility decision.

catalog_gate.api: Microsoft Planetary Computer public STAC API
catalog_gate.early_window: first observed season +/- 4 years, clipped to 1984-2025
catalog_gate.late_window: last observed season +/- 4 years, clipped to 1984-2025
catalog_gate.interpretation: Passing means catalog support exists for a later local-pixel QA. Failing this Level-2 catalog gate does not by itself prove that no usable Level-1/TOA imagery exists.

required_checks: local clear-pixel fraction inside the frozen site buffer
manual QA of a blinded subset before full extraction

marine_support.goal: Audit availability only; do not select predictors by correlation with demographic outcomes.
candidate_domains: distance or access cost to open water during breeding
remote-sensing productivity when temporal support is sufficient

staged_design: Stage A1: run the scene-catalog inventory with prohibited demographic fields physically absent from the audit object.
Stage A2: if catalog support is adequate, freeze and run local pixel-level QA without joining count magnitudes.
Stage B: define deterministic terrestrial eligibility and an accessible-habitat change metric; audit marine covariate support.
Stage C: freeze the eligible roster, terrestrial metric, marine covariate set, model family, nulls, and stop rule in a separate outcome contract.
Stage D: only then join demographic magnitudes and breeding-space outcomes.
no_outcome_rule: This audit can conclude that the new Paper 2 is technically feasible or infeasible, but cannot report any association between habitat change and abundance, concentration, persistence, colonization, or extinction.
branch_stop_rule: If support is insufficient, stop Paper 2 without lowering thresholds after seeing demographic outcomes; proceed to the separately defined dynamic-substrate Paper 3 route.
